source.description: the scanned splats this is made from (left unchanged); content path of a splats asset (no extension)
another scan merged in; content path of a splats asset (no extension)

position.description: where it goes in the source splats' coordinates; unit: m

scale.description: its uniform scale (phone scans often differ in scale)

merge.description: other scans merged in first (place them roughly, then auto-align); crop, erase and floaters apply to the merged result

center.description: center of the box in the source splats' own coordinates; unit: m

size.description: edge lengths of the box; unit: m

keep.description: crop boxes: only splats inside one of them are kept; nothing is cropped when missing

center.description: center of the box in the source splats' own coordinates; unit: m

size.description: edge lengths of the box; unit: m

remove.description: splats inside these boxes are removed

center.description: center of the sphere in the source splats' own coordinates; unit: m

radius.description: radius of the sphere; unit: m

erase.description: brush strokes: splats whose centers fall in these spheres are removed

cell.description: grid cell size for counting neighbors; unit: m

neighbors.description: splats with fewer than this many others in their own and the 26 surrounding cells float alone and are removed

minOpacity.description: splats more transparent than this are removed (off by default: many faint ones together are the soft light on floors and walls)

floaters.description: remove floaters: lone splats hanging in the air and nearly invisible ones; off when missing

exposure.description: exposure compensation in stops; unit: EV

temperature.description: color temperature of the light in the scan: that white becomes white; unit: K

tint.description: magenta (+) or green (-) shift of that white

color.description: color adjustment of the scan (scans differ in exposure and white balance), in linear light

cell.description: voxel size; grows automatically for very large scans; unit: m

minOpacity.description: splats more transparent than this are left out

density.description: opacity a voxel collects before it counts as solid (one lone opaque splat is not a wall)

minIsland.description: connected solid pieces with fewer voxels are dropped (floaters)

proxy.description: also generate a simplified proxy mesh (<name>.proxy model) for collision, shadows, ray tracing and sky occlusion: give it a model component with visibleInCamera off and a static mesh collider; not generated when missing
